meta.data_description_zh:
1. 國民健康署自民國 99 年起擴大辦理 4 項癌症（大腸癌、口腔癌、乳癌
及子宮頸癌）篩檢服務，透過全民健保預防保健服務特約醫事服務機構
全面提供大腸癌、乳癌、子宮頸癌與口腔癌篩檢，並將大腸癌、口腔癌
篩檢納入預防保健服務項目。
2. 大腸癌多發生在 50歲以後，國民健康署補助 50至未滿75歲民眾，每 2年進行
1次糞便潛血檢查。
3. 檢查結果若為陰性，國健署建議病患持續每 2年接受1次糞便潛血檢查；若為陽
性，建議接受大腸鏡檢查確診，無法做大腸鏡檢查時，可用鋇劑攝影+乙狀結腸
鏡檢查。
4. 大腸癌篩檢-大腸鏡檢查報告(H_BHP_CCS_CUT)內，以下 4 欄位係早期(國民健
康局時代)為辦理大腸鏡品質提升之相關計畫所收錄之資料，因資料收錄欄位已
調整，故無後續年度資料。

meta.data_description_en: 1. When counting visits, supplementary-report data should not be double-counted. 2. When computing fees, supplementary-report data should be combined. 3. The file format and data descriptions in this manual reference the NHI 'Medical Fee Point Reporting Format and Instructions for Contracted Facilities (outpatient, inpatient, delivery)' on the NHIA website. Note: This center's databases are de-identified; directly identifying fields such as name and address are removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insurer-unit code, tax ID, birth date, visit date, and admission date are masked; data may only be used on-site and only approved aggregate results exported, ensuring individuals cannot be re-identified.

meta.data_description_en: 1. From ROC year 99 (2010), the Health Promotion Administration expanded four cancer screenings (colorectal, oral, breast, cervical), providing them through NHI-contracted preventive-care facilities and adding colorectal and oral cancer screening to preventive-care services. 2. Colorectal cancer mostly occurs after age 50; the HPA funds a fecal occult blood test once every 2 years for people aged 50 to under 75. 3. If negative, the HPA recommends continuing the test every 2 years; if positive, colonoscopy is recommended for confirmation, and if colonoscopy is not possible, barium enema plus sigmoidoscopy may be used. 4. In the colorectal-screening colonoscopy report (H_BHP_CCS_CUT), the following 4 fields were collected in the early period (Bureau of Health Promotion era) for a colonoscopy-quality-improvement program; because the collected fields were later adjusted, there is no data for subsequent years.
